# Endorsements: Grunthaner For SJUSD Trustee Area 4 2026
#### Helen Chapman Campaign Endorsement
#### Supervisor Susan Ellenberg's Campaign Endorsement
#### Helen Chapman Campaign Endorsement
Helen Chapman, Santa Clara Valley Open Space, Endorses Mary Grunthaner for Trustee: "I am proud to endorse Mary Grunthaner for San Jose Unified School Board Trustee. Mary has dedicated her career to empowering students and with her inclusive leadership, deep knowledge, and background, she will serve our district well."
#### SJTA Campaign Endorsement
#### Supervisor Susan Ellenberg's Campaign Endorsement
#### Helen Chapman Campaign Endorsement
San Jose Teachers' Association endorses Mary Grunthaner's campaign to become the next Trustee for SJUSD's Area 4. It is an honor to get this endorsement.
#### Supervisor Susan Ellenberg's Campaign Endorsement
#### Supervisor Susan Ellenberg's Campaign Endorsement
#### Former Supervisor Ken Yeager's Campaign Endorsement
Santa Clara County Supervisor Susan Ellenberg Endorses Mary Grunthaner for Trustee
#### Former Supervisor Ken Yeager's Campaign Endorsement
#### San Jose City Councilman Peter Ortiz's Campaign Endorsement
#### Former Supervisor Ken Yeager's Campaign Endorsement
Former Santa Clara County Supervisor and Co-Founder of BAYMEC, Ken Yeager: I wholeheartedly endorse Mary Grunthaner to become the next Trustee for Area 4 of San Jose Unified School District. Continuing her lifelong commitment to public education is just what SJUSD's Board of Education needs to move in the direction that serves the best interests of San Jose's students, teachers, and our local community. Join me in electing her to the school board in November.
#### Dual Endorsement from South Bay Labor Council
#### San Jose City Councilman Peter Ortiz's Campaign Endorsement
#### San Jose City Councilman Peter Ortiz's Campaign Endorsement
Both candidates for Trustee have the support of South Bay Labor Council. It is an honor to get this endorsement.
#### San Jose City Councilman Peter Ortiz's Campaign Endorsement
#### San Jose City Councilman Peter Ortiz's Campaign Endorsement
#### San Jose City Councilman Peter Ortiz's Campaign Endorsement
San Jose City Councilman Peter Ortiz's Endorsement: "As a San Jose City Councilman and community member, I feel it is vitally important we elect trustees to the school board who have strong classroom and educational leadership skills to support our students, families, teachers and community. Mary Grunthaner is the Trustee Area 4 candidate who will ensure our students flourish."
#### Democrats for Public Education's Campaign Endorsement
#### Democratic Activists for Women Now [DAWN] Campaign Endorsement
#### Santa Clara County Democratic Party's Campaign Endorsement
The Democrats for Public Education has endorsed Mary Grunthaner to become the next Trustee for San Jose Unified's Area 4. It is an honor to get this endorsement.
#### Santa Clara County Democratic Party's Campaign Endorsement
#### Democratic Activists for Women Now [DAWN] Campaign Endorsement
#### Santa Clara County Democratic Party's Campaign Endorsement
The Santa Clara County Democratic Party has endorsed Mary Grunthaner to become the next Trustee for San Jose Unified's Area 4. It is an honor to get this endorsement.
#### Democratic Activists for Women Now [DAWN] Campaign Endorsement
#### Democratic Activists for Women Now [DAWN] Campaign Endorsement
#### Democratic Activists for Women Now [DAWN] Campaign Endorsement
On Sunday September 20th, DAWN endorsed Mary's campaign to become the next Trustee for SJUSD's Area 4. It is an honor to get this endorsement!
#### San Jose City Councilman Anthony Tordillos' Endorsement
#### San Jose City Councilman Anthony Tordillos' Endorsement
#### Democratic Activists for Women Now [DAWN] Campaign Endorsement
San Jose City Councilman Anthony Tordillos Endorses Mary Grunthaner for Trustee
